3. The event needs to be endorsed by the Office of Student Affairs (OSA).
4. Student organisations must book 2 weeks in advance. SoC does not entertain last-minute bookings.
5. SoC will confirm the booking after checking availability.
6. Organisers are responsible for participant safety and must ensure SoC property is not damaged or stolen during the event.
